notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year![/h1]

[h2]1.3 Update![/h2]

[h3]To start the year off well I've decided to push a quick update adding some long desired features, here is a list of everything that has been added.[/h3]

[list]
[*] Wearable hats accesible by the settings menu (cosmetic only)
[*] An in-game timer for those inclined to speedrun 89!
[/list]

it should also be stated that the invisible character glitch has been fixed, meaning the game is now playable!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE: VERSION 1.2!!!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey y'all, hope y'all have been feeling fine lately as us here at H-Pie for sure have! Version 1.2 is chock-full of exciting new features and updates, here is the complete list:[/h3]

[h2]New Gamemodes (accessible through cheat code, read the manual, all come with new achievements)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ultrahard Mode
[*] Easy Mode
[*] Hyperspeed Mode
[*] Small Mode
[*] Upside Down Mode
[*] Flipped Mode
[*] Invisible Mode
[/list]

[h2]QOL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Visible Hitbox Toggle
[*] Fixed Jump Animation
[*] Decluttered Menus (More Icons, Less Words)
[*] Borderless Fullscreen Support
[*] Cursor Hide/Show Toggle
[*] General Debugs
[/list]

on a sidenote, keep an eye out for [b]christmas day[/b], as you might have a little surprise. there is now also a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2134360/discussions/0/3468361193674369742/]thread[/url] in the community section where you guys can list features and improvements you would like to see, and they will most likely be added!

[h3]Hope y'all enjoy playing the new update![/h3]

notes.title: tiny little update - version 1.01
notes.content: the first patch is out, 1.01! this little patch fixes a single bug, now the menu music doesn't reset once you leave and re-enter the menu. a decently large update will be coming out later this month! p.s. the soundtrack will also be released here on steam in a few days.
